{{Quote|It's a mineral with a few limited applications, a couple of manufacturing processes. Some industrial solvents. That's about it. It used to be a lot more widely used, but times change.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], about damotite|<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''</ref>}}
'''Damotite''' was an [[Ore/Legends|ore]] of yellowish [[Color/Legends|color]] with [[poison]]ous properties, that was know to be found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]]. The mineral was highly sought after prior to the Clone Wars for the refinement of [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]], although was phased out in favor of the safer [[trenomite]]. It can also be used as a fuel in the liquid state. Sometime during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]] attempted to [[Damotite bioweapon|make]] a [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]] using damotite for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] with the help of an [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] [[Bant'ena Fhernan]]. On a mission to the planet Lanteeb, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], managed to prevent the weapon from being widely used, though not before it was used on the [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrilan]] capital, [[Hanna City/Legends|Hanna City]].
